finalCandidate.hypothesis: A mature higher-timeframe uptrend should reward controlled pullbacks that re-accelerate from EMA/structure.
finalCandidate.marketMechanism: Continuation buyers defend a known value area after weak counter-trend supply is absorbed.
finalCandidate.entryLogic: Bull trend age, one-to-four ATR pullback, close above EMA with positive momentum acceleration.
finalCandidate.invalidationLogic: Trend alignment breaks or the pullback exceeds the structural risk band.
finalCandidate.expectedFailureMode: Trend exhaustion and a deeper regime transition masked as a pullback.
finalCandidate.preregisteredHypothesis: A mature bull pullback is evaluated as a complementary LONG regime component under the same next-open and cost model.

candidate.hypothesis: Longer trend age and a deeper but still bounded pullback may improve entry location when volatility is elevated.
candidate.marketMechanism: A deeper liquidity sweep that holds structure can reset extension without invalidating the trend.
candidate.expectedRegime: BULL with elevated but non-spiking volatility
candidate.entryLogic: Deeper pullback, structure hold, bullish close and no late chase.
candidate.invalidationLogic: Structure breaks or price remains below EMA after the pullback.
candidate.expectedFailureMode: Trend age becomes exhaustion rather than continuation.
candidate.preregisteredHypothesis: Independent LONG hypothesis: a bounded liquidity reclaim after a deeper pullback may yield a positive asymmetric continuation in aligned bull regimes.

candidate.hypothesis: A lower threshold variant tests whether the structural idea survives realistic signal sparsity without a narrow optimum.
candidate.marketMechanism: Early but confirmed expansion may retain more of the move than late breakout entry.
candidate.entryLogic: Compression followed by positive expansion, moderate participation and no extreme extension.
candidate.invalidationLogic: Expansion fails to hold the compression boundary.
candidate.expectedFailureMode: False positive expansion in a range.
candidate.preregisteredHypothesis: Independent LONG hypothesis: a compressed volatility release with participation confirmation may preserve early continuation yield without changing any Production parameter.

finalCandidate.hypothesis: Requiring a stronger failed reclaim should reduce false reversals at the expense of sample size.
finalCandidate.marketMechanism: Repeated inability to hold the breakout level creates asymmetric downside once trapped demand capitulates.
finalCandidate.entryLogic: High-volume upside break, two-bar failure, failed reclaim and momentum turn below the level.
finalCandidate.expectedFailureMode: The market is trending and the failed breakout is only a pause.
finalCandidate.preregisteredHypothesis: A slightly relaxed extension cap with still-high participation tests entry yield around the failed reclaim.

candidate.hypothesis: A lower-volume rejection variant tests whether failed structure, rather than volume alone, carries the reversal signal.
candidate.marketMechanism: The key information is inability to hold the breakout, not the absolute size of participation.
candidate.entryLogic: Upside probe, close below the level, lower high, bearish candle and bounded extension.
candidate.invalidationLogic: Higher-high reclaim or lack of downside confirmation.
candidate.preregisteredHypothesis: A lower-volume rejection with a lower high may capture wick-led supply rejection; this remains a research adapter over the existing failed-breakout detector.

candidate.hypothesis: A support breakdown followed by a controlled retest from below can provide cleaner short entries than late trend rejection.
candidate.marketMechanism: Former support becomes overhead supply after trapped longs exit on the retest.
candidate.entryLogic: Prior-bar clean support breakdown, retest of former support, bearish close and controlled downside extension.
candidate.invalidationLogic: Retest reclaims support or the stop is hit before target.
candidate.expectedFailureMode: Breakdown is absorbed and becomes a bear trap.
candidate.preregisteredHypothesis: A support break followed by a bounded retest may improve short entry timing versus late trend rejection.

candidate.hypothesis: Higher-volume, longer-lookback breakdowns may reduce noise while preserving a retest edge.
candidate.marketMechanism: A broad support failure attracts trend followers and offers a defined invalidation on the retest.
candidate.entryLogic: Thirty-bar support break, strong volume, shallow retest and rejection.
candidate.invalidationLogic: Reclaim of support or a retest wider than the defined ATR distance.
candidate.preregisteredHypothesis: A longer-lookback, high-participation breakdown tests whether continuation quality improves at the cost of yield.

candidate.hypothesis: A failed upside breakout with reclaim failure can expose trapped breakout buyers and create a distinct reversal edge.
candidate.marketMechanism: Failed expansion leaves late longs positioned above invalidation while downside confirmation accelerates exits.
candidate.entryLogic: Recent upside break, loss of breakout level, failed reclaim, bearish confirmation and no late downside chase.
candidate.expectedFailureMode: Breakout resumes after a shallow shakeout.
candidate.preregisteredHypothesis: A less restrictive failed-breakout variant may be useful only in the range-to-bear transition, which is evaluated by regime slices rather than tuned after results.

candidate.hypothesis: A mature higher-timeframe downtrend should reward controlled rebounds that reject resistance and re-accelerate lower.
candidate.marketMechanism: Counter-trend supply is absorbed at value/resistance before continuation sellers regain control.
candidate.entryLogic: Bear trend age, one-to-four ATR rebound, close below EMA and negative momentum acceleration.
candidate.invalidationLogic: Trend alignment breaks or rebound exceeds the structural risk band.
candidate.expectedFailureMode: Downtrend is ending and rebound becomes a reversal.
candidate.preregisteredHypothesis: A mature bearish trend pullback is a separate continuation component for a fixed regime ensemble, not a replacement of the Production strategy.
